description:
## [1.34.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.34.0) (2026-10-27)

### Bug Fixes

* Fixed streaming AND downloads still broken in v1.33.0. CloudFrontPlayInfoClient was not sending the X-Client-Build header on direct play-info requests. Now sends it on ALL requests (OkHttp + CloudFront). Same fix as hxreborn v1.65.0-dev.4. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK.**
